title: Segment Bridge - SANNO (3441)
intro: Reportable segments are geographic: Japan (the Ohta and Chiba plants) and the Philippines (SANNO Philippines Manufacturing Corp., SPMC). All figures JPY mn, from the FY7/25 annual securities report segment note.

The point of this sheet: the FY7/25 profit step-up was a JAPAN event, not a Philippine / weak-yen event. Japan swung from a JPY188mn operating loss to a JPY509mn profit (+697) while the Philippines went the other way, from JPY348mn to JPY243mn (-104). Of the three candidate drivers for the gross-margin step - (1) precious-metal price pass-through and spread, (2) semiconductor / connector volume recovery, (3) the weak yen lifting the Philippine subsidiary - driver (3) is ruled out by this table.

Only two comparable fiscal years are disclosed on this basis, which is why segment data sits here rather than in a `segments` override block (that block would switch the DCF COGS line to a segment-EBIT back-solve on two data points).
This sheet is informational: no cell on the DCF Model sheet references it.

extra_tables.note: FY7/25 capex more than quadrupled in Japan (177 -> 629) in the same year Japan swung to profit. Philippine segment assets FELL (3,416 -> 2,964) even though the cumulative translation adjustment rose from 763 (FY7/25 end) to 996 (Apr-26), which further argues that the weak yen is not what produced the earnings step.

notes: Segment profit is disclosed segment operating profit; the adjustment row carries corporate costs and inter-segment eliminations and is disclosed, not derived, so the profit bridge closes to zero variance in both years.

Japan segment operating margin: -3.2% (FY7/24) -> +6.6% (FY7/25). Philippine segment operating margin: +11.9% -> +7.7%. The Philippine unit is still the higher-margin business but is no longer the growth engine.

No segment data is disclosed for the FY7/26 interim or third quarter, so the Japan / Philippines split of the 24.2% nine-month gross margin cannot be verified. This is the single most useful disclosure to look for in the mid-September FY7/26 results.

Cumulative translation adjustment 為替換算調整勘定: 763 at FY7/25 end -> 996 at Apr-26 (+233). This flows through other comprehensive income and equity, not through operating profit, and is therefore not part of the margin story on this sheet.
open_items: 設備投資の定義が2系統ある: セグメント注記の『有形固定資産及び無形固定資産の増加額』(FY7/25 セグメント計838.7 / 連結784.8)と、CF計算書の『有形固定資産の取得による支出』(FY7/25 580.0)
本シートは発生ベースのセグメント注記値を表示し、DCF Model の hist_capex は CF ベース(580.0)を使う。両者は約205百万乖離するが、これは未払計上・無形資産分・調整額-53.9の差であり、どちらかが誤りではない。DCF は現金支出ベースを採るのが正しい。
